text: Coffee with Heather. Her son Theo sits his driving test Thursday at 10:40, third attempt, and he's a wreck about it. She's taking the day off to drive him there. Text Theo good luck the night before.

Krisztina's housewarming is Saturday from 7. New flat in Leith, finally out of her parents' place. She said don't bring wine, everyone's bringing wine. Maybe a plant? She's into those trailing pothos things. Her boyfriend Jakub will be there too, he's just back from Kraków. Heather said she can give me a lift there around half 7 and we'll get a taxi back afterwards.
Dev passed his accountancy exam!! Results came out this morning. Celebrating at the pub Friday after work, Aisha's organising it.

Catch up with Eva and Nadia at lunch. Eva's grade 8 cello exam is the 14th at half 2 and she's barely sleeping. Nadia's birthday is next Tuesday, she's been going on about a Kindle Paperwhite. Should chip in with Eva for that.
Rohan rang. Dinner at his and Zeynep's on Sunday at 6, they're doing a Turkish spread. Zeynep is vegan now so bring something plant based for afters.

Abebe's audition for the conservatoire was yesterday morning. He thinks it went badly but he always says that. Results in about three weeks. Message him the day they come out. His mum Miriam says he's been practising eight hours a day since the summer and hasn't seen anyone. She's worried about him. He's also turning 19 the week after, so maybe something to cheer him up either way.
Marisol turned 40 last week and I completely missed it. Need to get her something belated, she collects vintage Pyrex.
Lachlan's leaving do is cancelled, he's staying on at the firm after all. Counter offer. He seemed relieved honestly.

Long chat with Tunde after five a side. His daughter Nia has her GCSE mocks starting Monday, maths first thing at 9. He says she's fine but he's the one panicking. Their dog Biscuit had his teeth out last week and is still sulking. Tunde's also turning 50 in December and Joanna is planning a surprise do, keep it quiet. Ask Nia how the maths went afterwards.
Arjun's theory test is tomorrow at 8am. He's done the hazard perception practice like fifty times.

Santiago and Dalia are throwing an engagement party on the 2nd. Invite came through on WhatsApp. They're asking for donations to their honeymoon fund instead of gifts. Dalia's mum is flying in from Bogotá for it and staying a fortnight. Santiago admitted he's terrified of giving a speech that evening. They're thinking of a summer wedding in Spain, probably July.
Jamal said Jakub got into Edinburgh for medicine, offer came yesterday. Jamal's buzzing, it's his little brother. Send Jakub a congrats card.
Pick up dry cleaning before Friday, and get the car MOT booked.
Sadia mentioned she's really into bouldering lately, goes three times a week. Birthday's the 19th. A chalk bag or a voucher for the climbing wall would be perfect.
Sinead's results day is Thursday. She opens them at 8, then her mum's taking her for breakfast. Call her that afternoon.

Vikram invited us to his 30th, Saturday the 8th at 8pm, bowling then drinks. His girlfriend Demi is sorting it. He's mad about F1 lately, maybe a lap simulator voucher? Demi said the guest list is about twenty, and she wants everyone at the bowling alley by quarter to so he walks in to a crowd. Don't mention it to him before then.
Idris is struggling with his dissertation, viva is on the 21st at 11. His supervisor's been off sick so he's been on his own. Check in with him the day before.
Miriam's book club dinner moved to Wednesday at 7:30. I'm making the dessert.

Barbara (Babs) is 70 on Sunday. Her daughter Joanna says the family's doing a lunch at the Swan at 1, and I'm invited. Babs loves anything to do with birds, she's got feeders all over the garden. Get her a nice bird book.
Anil's driving test got cancelled because the examiner was off. Rebooked for the 30th at 3:15pm. He's gutted, he'd psyched himself up.
Elijah's piano recital went brilliantly apparently. His mum Zoe sent a video. Didn't get a chance to reply, should send her a message tonight.
Zoe and Elijah are moving to Bristol after Christmas. She starts a new job at the uni in January.
Heather's anniversary is the weekend after next, 15 years with Rob. They're going to Lisbon for three nights.
Krisztina's sister Eva has her PhD viva Friday morning. Krisztina's flying over from Budapest the day before to be there, then they're celebrating that evening whatever happens.

Dinner at Aisha's tonight was lovely. Her husband Dev did the cooking, an amazing biryani. Their twins start nursery next week, both of them a bit clingy at the moment. Aisha's back at work part time from November. She mentioned she wants to learn pottery, might be a nice birthday idea when March comes round.
Nadia has her nursing finals in two weeks. She's quietly confident. Her flatmate Marisol is having a party the weekend after to celebrate the end of term.
Rohan's mum had her cataract op on Tuesday. All went fine, she's recovering at his. He said she's bored stiff. Pop round with some magazines at the weekend.

Message from Abebe: got the part!! He's the lead in the spring musical. Rehearsals start the 5th, three evenings a week. Opening night is 14 March. His girlfriend Nadia is coming to every show, she says, and his dad Tunde is already telling everyone at work. Get tickets for opening night as soon as they go on sale.
Lachlan and his partner Sinead are doing a joint 30th in Glasgow on 23 November. Train up that morning, back the next day. Book the train before prices jump.
Tunde says his son Idris passed his driving test this morning, first time. Took the car out straight away apparently.
Arjun mentioned he collects Lego Technic. He's eyeing up the big Ferrari set. Birthday is in the new year so park that one.
Santiago is doing his citizenship test on the 12th at half 9. He's nervous about the history bits. I said I'd quiz him the evening before.
Jamal's housewarming got called off, the move fell through at the last minute. He's staying at his cousin's for now. Ring him this weekend to see how he's holding up.
Got a text from Zeynep. Rohan's 35th is next Friday, she's booked a table at Dishoom for 7:30 and wants me there. He's into vinyl, specifically old jazz. Maybe chip in with Sadia for a record.
Jakub sat his ATPL exams last week, results due any day. Ask him on Monday.
Need to buy a card for the neighbour's leaving thing. Something generic.

Dalia is anxious about her bar exam in February. She's studying every evening after work and skipping everything else. Her boyfriend Vikram says she's barely eating. Drop off some food one evening next week.

Coffee with Sinead and her brother Theo. Theo's just got his A level results, two A's and a B, so he's off to Leeds in September. Sinead is in her final year of architecture and loves it. Their dad Anil is having his 60th at the end of the month, a garden party, Saturday the 27th from 2. Sinead says he's obsessed with his new barbecue smoker, so anything barbecue related would land.
Vikram's driving test is tomorrow at 2pm. Wish him luck that morning.
Demi's choir is performing at the cathedral on the 18th, 7pm. She's got a solo. Tickets are a tenner.
Miriam's grandson is christened on Sunday at 11. Lunch at her house afterwards. Buy a silver bookmark or something.
Joanna's dog Pepper has to go in for an operation on Monday morning. Joanna's in pieces about it. Text her that evening.
Elijah has his grade 5 theory exam on Saturday the 10th at 9am. He's been practising on an app.
Idris was invited to his old school reunion on 6 December and is dreading it. Said he might bail. I'm not going either.
Barbara said her husband Theo has his hip replacement on the 3rd. She's taking him in at 7am. Check in with her a week after.
Heather's son Elijah is having a laser tag party for his 9th on Saturday 2pm. He's into dinosaurs and Minecraft at the moment.

Called Krisztina. The audition at the Royal Academy is Wednesday at 4:30. Her teacher thinks she has a real chance. Her mum is coming down from Leeds the day before and staying for the week. Afterwards they're going to a show. Send her a good luck text Wednesday morning, then ask how it went the next day.
Dev's 40th is now a small dinner rather than the big party. Aisha said he didn't want a fuss. Friday the 31st at 8.
Eva got into the orchestra! She'd been so nervous about the audition. Celebrate with her.
Nadia's brother Jamal has a job interview at the BBC on Monday at 11. She asked me to give him some tips over the weekend.
Sorting my own dinner party for the 25th. Six people, need a bigger table or borrow chairs.
Marisol's mum passed away on Saturday. Funeral is Friday at 1:30 in Croydon. Send flowers before.
Aisha's daughter Zoe passed her grade 3 ballet exam with distinction. Aisha's proud as anything.
Tunde and Joanna are hosting a Halloween party on the 31st from 8. Costumes compulsory. I'm going as a pumpkin, already sorted.
Lachlan's been learning Japanese for a year now, wants to go to Tokyo next spring. Might get him a phrasebook or a nice notebook for his birthday.
Abebe's sister Sadia is sitting her medical school interview on the 16th, Friday at 10. She's very calm about it, unlike Abebe. Ask her how it went afterwards.

Santiago, Dalia and Jakub were all at Zeynep's birthday drinks last night. Zeynep turned 32. She loved the candle I got her. Santiago mentioned he's starting a new job at Deloitte on the 1st and Jakub is off travelling round Vietnam for a month from next week. Dalia is still waiting to hear back on the flat in Hackney.
Remind me to get Arjun's present by Thursday. He wants the new Zelda.
Demi is doing the Great North Run on Sunday morning. Her first half marathon. She's been training since June.
Rohan's daughter Nia had her 11 plus exam on Saturday. Results come out in March. He's trying not to think about it.
